description: Season-0 private pool (pool/README.md): per task, `forts` start forts built from secret world seeds. `candidates` seeds are drawn and committed per task; the pool takes the first `forts` that pass the embark rules, in ascending seed order, so spares are committed too and nobody can pick which forts are used. Public; holds no secret.
seed_mode_note: EMBARK_SEED_IN_PARAMS=1: the full seed goes into the param set (DF's `-gen` keeps only the low 8 bits of a CLI seed, so CLI seeds collide with train seeds mod 256; research/seed-portability.md fix 2). Changes every embark id: private forts never match a CLI-seed fort.

my1.note: accept a day-120 fort only if the arm kept everyone alive, has >= 7 citizens, and holds at least 60 days of drink at the trim_stocks.lua rate (else the lean hand-over has nothing to trim). No food clause (min_food_days 0, 2026-10-26): under score v6 only edible food counts, and edible food at day 120 is already below the 60-day target, so the trim moves drink only (D20) and a food clause would reject most candidates

public.note: Public-seed forts for competitors' local runs (CLI seeds, as the existing test-public pools). Labs: docker/task_forts.sh (runner/yukon/setup.sh); OP1: the default start fort (docker/embark.sh --rules DEFAULT_FORT); MY1: pool/dfpool build-public --task MY1 --seeds 2001,2002,2005.
